class.name: OcgGraphic3dAspecttext3d
class.brief_description: Creates and updates a group of attributes for text primitives.
class.description: ! Creates and updates a group of attributes for text primitives.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates a context table for text primitives defined with the following default values: Color : Quantity_NOC_YELLOW Font : Font_NOF_ASCII_MONO The style : Aspect_TOST_NORMAL The display type : Aspect_TODT_NORMAL

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a context table for text primitives defined with the specified values.

method.name: SetStyle
method.description: Modifies the style of the text.

method.name: SetDisplayType
method.description: Define the display type of the text.

method.name: GetTextZoomable
method.description: Returns TRUE when the Text Zoomable is on.
